sentences.en: And what is so unusual about this search is that we already know what Trump wanted in a vice president from his 2016 campaign when he picked Mike Pence.
sentences.zh: 这次搜寻最不同寻常之处在于，我们已经知道特朗普在2016年竞选时选择迈克·彭斯作为副总统时想要的是什么。

sentences.en: And we know how badly that all ended with Trump openly denouncing Pence for not helping him overturn his 2020 election loss and reportedly endorsing calls for Pence's death,

sentences.en: It's a very different calculus this time around.

sentences.en: So, Mike, tell us about these top three contenders at this moment for Trump's vice presidential slot and how Trump is thinking about each of them.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，请跟我们聊聊目前特朗普副总统人选的三大热门，以及特朗普对他们各自的看法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: One we can start with is the senator from Ohio, J.D.
sentences.zh: 我们可以先从俄亥俄州参议员J.D.说起。

sentences.en: Vance.
sentences.zh: 万斯。

sentences.en: Despite all outward appearances, I'm a cultural outsider.
sentences.zh: 尽管外表看起来如此，但我其实是个文化上的局外人。

sentences.en: I didn't come from the elites.
sentences.zh: 我并非出身精英阶层。

sentences.en: Most listeners will probably remember J.D.
sentences.zh: 大多数听众可能还记得J.D.

sentences.en: Vance as the guy who burst onto the national scene with a book about his time growing up in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 万斯，他凭借一本关于自己在俄亥俄州成长经历的书，一跃进入了全国公众的视野。

sentences.en: I came from a southern Ohio steel town.
sentences.zh: 我来自俄亥俄州南部的一个钢铁小镇。

sentences.en: And it's a town that's really struggling in a lot of ways, ways that are indicative of the broader struggles of America's working class.
sentences.zh: 那个小镇在很多方面都举步维艰，而这些困境正是美国工人阶级普遍挣扎的缩影。

sentences.en: That sort of explained the forgotten man and woman in America right at the time that Trump was leveraging that idea to become president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上解释了当时美国那些被遗忘的男男女女，而特朗普正是利用这一理念成为了美国总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Here with me is J.D.
sentences.zh: 和我在一起的是J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, author of Hillbilly Elegy.
sentences.zh: 万斯，《乡下人的悲歌》的作者。

sentences.en: J.D.
sentences.zh: J.D.

sentences.en: has been unlocking the mysteries to Donald Trump's appeal.
sentences.zh: 一直在破解唐纳德·特朗普吸引力的奥秘。

sentences.en: J.D.
sentences.zh: J.D.

sentences.en: Vance went on a national book tour.
sentences.zh: 万斯进行了一次全国性的新书巡回宣传。

sentences.en: He was on television, on podcasts, talking about his book.
sentences.zh: 他上了电视，参加了播客，谈论他的书。

sentences.en: Donald Trump, if nothing else, is relatable to the average working class American because he speaks off the cuff.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普至少能让普通的美国工人阶级产生共鸣，因为他说话直来直去。

sentences.en: Even if, you know, half of the things that he says don't make any sense or a quarter of the things that he says are offensive.
sentences.zh: 即使，你知道，他说的东西有一半毫无意义，或者四分之一的内容令人反感。

sentences.en: But also talking pretty negatively about Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但也曾非常负面地谈论过唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I can't stomach Trump.
sentences.zh: 我无法忍受特朗普。

sentences.en: I think that he's noxious and is leading the white working class to a very dark place.
sentences.zh: 我认为他很恶毒，正在把白人工人阶级引向一个非常黑暗的地方。

sentences.en: And ultimately, I mean, he was really scathing in how he depicted Donald Trump as a effectively
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我的意思是，他当时在描述唐纳德·特朗普时确实非常尖刻，实际上把他描绘成

sentences.en: a con artist who was taking advantage of the people that he was writing about to sort of fuel his political rise.
sentences.zh: 一个骗子，利用他书中描写的人来助推自己的政治崛起。

sentences.en: Look, I wasn't a big Trump guy in 2016, but I think he did a good job.
sentences.zh: 听着，我在2016年并不是特朗普的支持者，但我认为他做得不错。

sentences.en: Until he changed his mind on Trump.
sentences.zh: 直到他改变了对特朗普的看法。

sentences.en: That's why I supported him in 2020.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我在2020年支持他。

sentences.en: And I think the recognition that I changed my mind is one of the reasons why the president came and endorsed me.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，承认我改变了主意，是总统亲自来为我背书的原因之一。

sentences.en: And that comes a few years later when Vance decides to run for Senate in 2022.
sentences.zh: 几年后，万斯决定在2022年竞选参议员，情况就发生了变化。

sentences.en: I actually aligned with the America First movement on the core issues.
sentences.zh: 我在核心议题上实际上与“美国优先”运动保持了一致。

sentences.en: By then, he had come, you know, 180 degrees on Trump.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他在特朗普的问题上已经来了个180度大转弯。

sentences.en: Trump was right that we need to make things in this country again so that we're self-sufficient.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说得对，我们需要让这个国家重新实现制造，这样我们才能自给自足。

sentences.en: And this works for Vance.
sentences.zh: 这对万斯很有效。

sentences.en: He wins Trump's endorsement, beats a pretty crowded field for the Republican nomination in Ohio, and wins election in 2022, which, if you remember, it was a pretty tough year
sentences.zh: 他赢得了特朗普的背书，在俄亥俄州共和党初选中击败了众多竞争对手，并赢得了2022年的选举。如果你还记得的话，那一年对于

sentences.en: for Trump endorsements.
sentences.zh: 特朗普背书的候选人来说相当艰难。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A lot of Trump picks in big states loSt.
sentences.zh: 很多特朗普力挺的人在大州都输了。

sentences.en: And J.D.
sentences.zh: 而J.D.

sentences.en: Vance was sort of the crown jewel of that election for the former president.
sentences.zh: 万斯算是前总统在那场选举中的“掌上明珠”。

sentences.en: So a rather convenient transformation from Trump critic to Trump fan results in J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以，从特朗普的批评者到特朗普的粉丝，这种相当便利的转变让J.D.

sentences.en: Vance winning a seat in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 万斯赢得了美国

sentences.en: Senate.
sentences.zh: 参议院的一个席位。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And he has become one of Trump's fiercest defenders in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 他已经成为特朗普在参议院最坚定的捍卫者之一。

sentences.en: Support the president.
sentences.zh: 支持总统。

sentences.en: Volunteer for him.
sentences.zh: 为他做志愿者。

sentences.en: Donate for him.
sentences.zh: 为他捐款。

sentences.en: And please, for the love of God, vote for him in November.
sentences.zh: 求求你们，看在上帝的份上，在十一月投票给他。

sentences.en: And he's a constant presence on the media circuit.
sentences.zh: 而且他经常出现在媒体圈。

sentences.en: Number one, I'm here for the simple reason to show support for a friend.
sentences.zh: 第一，我来这里的原因很简单，就是为了表达对朋友的支持。

sentences.en: I think this trial is absolutely ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 我认为这场审判简直荒谬至极。

sentences.en: I think it's a sham prosecution.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一场虚假的起诉。

sentences.en: Most recently, he was in Manhattan sitting with Trump in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 最近，他还在曼哈顿的法庭里陪着特朗普坐着。

sentences.en: I think this is disgraceful.
sentences.zh: 我认为这太可耻了。

sentences.en: I don't care what you call it, Wolf.
sentences.zh: 我不管你怎么称呼它，沃尔夫。

sentences.en: Trump is disgraceful?
sentences.zh: 特朗普很可耻？

sentences.en: Is that what you're saying?
sentences.zh: 你是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: I think this proceeding, this legal proceeding is disgraceful.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个程序，这个法律程序是可耻的。

sentences.en: And then fighting for Trump, defending him and criticizing the prosecution in front of the TV cameras afterward.
sentences.zh: 随后在电视摄像机前为特朗普辩护，并批评检方。

sentences.en: I don't care what you call this, but this is not the America that I know and love.
sentences.zh: 我不管你怎么称呼这个，但这绝不是我所了解和热爱的美国。

sentences.en: Why aren't we talking about inflation, Wolf?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不谈谈通货膨胀，沃尔夫？

sentences.en: Why aren't we talking about Biden's wide open southern border?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不谈谈拜登大开的南部边境？

sentences.en: This entire trial was cooked up to distract from Joe Biden's failures.
sentences.zh: 整场审判都是为了转移人们对乔·拜登失败政绩的注意力而炮制的。

sentences.en: This is exactly what Trump wants in a vice president.
sentences.zh: 这正是特朗普想要的副总统人选。

sentences.en: Vance is maybe the best in this top tier at defending Trump publicly.
sentences.zh: 万斯或许是这第一梯队中最擅长公开捍卫特朗普的人。

sentences.en: He knows when to become a fire-breathing ideologue.
sentences.zh: 他知道什么时候该化身为激进的意识形态斗士。

sentences.en: He knows when to turn the temperature down and become self-effacing and sort of brush off tough questions.
sentences.zh: 他也知道什么时候该降低姿态，变得谦逊，并巧妙地化解尖锐的问题。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So he's definitely got the very good on TV box checked.
sentences.zh: 所以他绝对符合“电视表现出色”这一项。

sentences.en: And as you said earlier in our conversation, that's just essential.
sentences.zh: 正如你在我们谈话早些时候所说，这至关重要。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: But I do think when it comes to Senator Vance, some of these strengths could be risks for him when it comes to making Trump's ticket.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，对于万斯参议员来说，其中一些优势在进入特朗普竞选搭档名单时可能会成为风险。

sentences.en: He is very ambitious and he is very young.
sentences.zh: 他非常有野心，而且非常年轻。

sentences.en: If Vice President Vance is sworn in next year, there will be immediate speculation about his potential running in 2028 as a president.
sentences.zh: 如果万斯副总统明年宣誓就职，人们会立即猜测他是否会在2028年竞选总统。

sentences.en: Ah, so you're saying he runs the risk of overshadowing Trump, which is a cardinal sin in Trump's book.
sentences.zh: 啊，所以你是说他有盖过特朗普风头的风险，这在特朗普的准则里可是大忌。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And right now, in my reporting, that's a strike against Vance when it comes to VP contention.
sentences.zh: 目前根据我的报道，在副总统人选竞争中，这对万斯来说是一个减分项。

sentences.en: Okay, so Mike, who's next on the list of Trump's top three contenders at the moment?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么迈克，特朗普目前三大热门人选名单上的下一位是谁？

sentences.en: Next on the list is someone you remember well, Michael, Senator Marco Rubio from Florida.
sentences.zh: 名单上的下一位是你很熟悉的人，迈克尔，来自佛罗里达州的参议员马可·卢比奥。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, you were pretty key in covering his 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 是的，你在报道他2016年的竞选活动时发挥了关键作用。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And like Vance, Mike, he has been on a very long journey of mocking and then trying to reconcile with Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且和万斯一样，迈克，他也经历了一段漫长的嘲讽特朗普，然后试图与特朗普和解的过程。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, Rubio was the rising star of the Republican Party pre-Trump, the son of Cuban immigrants
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，卢比奥在特朗普出现之前是共和党的明日之星，他是古巴移民的儿子，

sentences.en: with a very powerful story of his own bootstraps rise and was seen as a potential frontrunner for the Republican nomination until Trump showed up on the scene.
sentences.zh: 有着非常励志的个人奋斗史，曾被视为共和党提名的潜在领跑者，直到特朗普出现在舞台上。

sentences.en: He doesn't sweat because his pores are clogged from the spray tan that he uses.
sentences.zh: 他不出汗，因为他的毛孔被他用的美黑喷雾堵住了。

sentences.en: And Rubio's response to Trump was pretty wild.
sentences.zh: 而卢比奥对特朗普的回应相当疯狂。

sentences.en: Donald is not going to make America great.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德不会让美国再次伟大。

sentences.en: He's going to make America orange.
sentences.zh: 他会让美国变成橙色。

sentences.en: What Rubio did was basically try to match Trump with schoolyard taunts.
sentences.zh: 卢比奥的做法基本上就是试图用校园霸凌式的嘲讽来回击特朗普。

sentences.en: Then he asked for a full length mirror.
sentences.zh: 然后他要了一面全身镜。

sentences.en: I don't know why, because the podium goes up to here, but he wanted a full length mirror.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么，因为讲台只到这里，但他想要一面全身镜。

sentences.en: Maybe to make sure his pants weren't wet.
sentences.zh: 也许是为了确保他的裤子没湿。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: He went after Trump on the debate stage.
sentences.zh: 他在辩论台上攻击特朗普。

sentences.en: If he builds the wall the way he built Trump Towers, he'll be using illegal immigrant labor to do it.
sentences.zh: 如果他建造边境墙的方式和他建造特朗普大厦一样，他会雇佣非法移民劳工来做。

sentences.en: You know, went after his personal life as, you know, the three divorces.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还攻击了他的私生活，比如，三次离婚。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know anything about bankrupting four companies.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我对让四家公司破产一无所知。

sentences.en: His multiple bankruptcies and in pretty colorful language.
sentences.zh: 他多次破产，而且用词相当生动。

sentences.en: So I'm looking at little Marco and I say, man, there's something happening with him.
sentences.zh: 所以我看着小马可，我说，伙计，他身上出事了。

sentences.en: Trump returned fire even more so and really just demolished Rubio in aggressively personal terMs.
sentences.zh: 特朗普进行了更猛烈的回击，并以极具人身攻击性的言辞彻底摧毁了卢比奥。

sentences.en: And I see him starting to sweat like I have never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 我看到他开始出汗，我从来没见过这样的场面。

sentences.en: Said how much he was sweating on the stage.
sentences.zh: 提到了他在台上出汗有多严重。

sentences.en: Thank God he has really large ears.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝，他有非常大的耳朵。

sentences.en: The biggest ears I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 我见过最大的耳朵。

sentences.en: Made fun of his ears, portrayed him as a lightweight who shouldn't be president, couldn't go toe-to-toe with any other foreign leaders, and really set him back politically.
sentences.zh: 嘲笑他的耳朵，把他描绘成一个不该当总统的轻量级选手，无法与其他外国领导人平起平坐，这确实在政治上让他受挫。

sentences.en: You know, I called him a lightweight.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我叫他轻量级选手。

sentences.en: I said at one point he was a lightweight.
sentences.zh: 我曾一度说他是轻量级选手。

sentences.en: And I don't mean to be insulting, but I do describe people somehow well.
sentences.zh: 我无意冒犯，但我确实很擅长描述人。

sentences.en: I mean, suffice it to say, by the end of the 2016 race, the concept that there could ever be a Trump-Rubio ticket was completely unfathomable.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，可以说，到2016年大选结束时，出现“特朗普-卢比奥”竞选搭档的概念是完全不可想象的。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实。

sentences.en: But what a lot of people don't realize is that Rubio really repaired that relationship with
sentences.zh: 但很多人没有意识到的是，卢比奥确实修复了与

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的关系。

sentences.en: Rubio won more votes in his Senate race in Florida than Trump did for president in Florida.
sentences.zh: 卢比奥在佛罗里达州参议员选举中获得的选票比特朗普在佛罗里达州竞选总统时获得的还要多。

sentences.en: And that was oddly important to Trump.
sentences.zh: 这在特朗普看来奇怪地重要。

sentences.en: He brought that up repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 他反复提到这一点。

sentences.en: Trump likes winners, right?
sentences.zh: 特朗普喜欢赢家，对吧？

sentences.en: And Rubio had won more votes than him.
sentences.zh: 而卢比奥获得的选票比他多。

sentences.en: So there must be, he must have missed something.
sentences.zh: 所以他一定，他一定错过了什么。

sentences.en: He invited Rubio over to the White House early on as sort of a charm offensive with Rubio.
sentences.zh: 他很早就邀请卢比奥去白宫，作为一种对卢比奥的魅力攻势。

sentences.en: And in the next few years, Rubio really did become a behind-the-scenes close advisor for
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，卢比奥确实成为了特朗普在外交政策和其他领域

sentences.en: Trump on foreign policy and some other areas.
sentences.zh: 幕后的亲密顾问。

sentences.en: And now, heading into 2024, Trump trusts him, views him as a valuable ally, and maybe even more than that, as a pretty effective attack dog.
sentences.zh: 现在，进入2024年，特朗普信任他，视他为宝贵的盟友，甚至可能不仅仅是盟友，而是一个相当有效的攻击犬。

sentences.en: Right now, with Joe Biden in the White House, our adversaries are going to conclude that there
sentences.zh: 现在，随着乔·拜登入主白宫，我们的对手会得出结论，认为有些事情他们可以侥幸逃脱，

sentences.en: are things they can get away with and they can do, because this White House is not strong, they're not prepared, they're not even competent, and I fear what that means.
sentences.zh: 他们可以为所欲为，因为这个白宫并不强大，他们没有准备好，甚至没有能力，我担心这意味着什么。

sentences.en: This is a big, big problem.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常非常大的问题。

sentences.en: Rubio has gotten very aggressive on television, going after the Biden administration, and really the president himself.
sentences.zh: 卢比奥在电视上变得非常有攻击性，抨击拜登政府，实际上是抨击总统本人。

sentences.en: If we have another four years of Joe Biden, I don't know what this country is going to look like, but none of us are going to be happy about it.
sentences.zh: 如果我们再有四年的乔·拜登，我不知道这个国家会变成什么样，但我们谁都不会为此感到高兴。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Clearly no accident, because he knows he's in contention for the VP spot.
sentences.zh: 显然这绝非偶然，因为他知道自己在竞争副总统的位置。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Just to put a fine point on it, you would say yes if you were asked to serve as his vice presidential nominee?
sentences.zh: 明确一点，如果有人邀请你担任他的副总统候选人，你会答应吗？

sentences.en: That would be presumptuous for me.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说太自以为是了。

sentences.en: I think anyone who's offered that job, to serve this country in the second highest office, assuming everything else in your life makes sense at that moment, if you're interested
sentences.zh: 我认为任何被提供这份工作，去为这个国家服务，担任第二高职位的人，假设你当时生活中的一切都顺理成章，如果你有兴趣

sentences.en: in serving the country, it's an incredible place to serve.
sentences.zh: 为国家服务，那是一个令人难以置信的服务岗位。

sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
